items.headline: Solana's Orca Merges With Loopscale for AI Push
items.summary: Solana DEX Orca is merging with Loopscale to expand into onchain financing for AI, robotics and defense — a fresh DeFi use case beyond swaps.

items.headline: Base Ships Cobalt Upgrade With Seize Function
items.summary: Base's third upgrade of the year adds conditional transactions and changes to the B20 token standard, including a controversial seize function.

items.headline: Samsung Brings USDC Transfers to Solana Galaxy Users
items.summary: Samsung will enable USDC transfers on Solana for US Galaxy smartphone users, a big mainstream adoption win for the $SOL ecosystem.

items.headline: Vitalik Warns on Hasty Wallet Migrations Amid AI Risk
items.summary: Vitalik Buterin cautions $ETH users not to rush wallet migrations despite growing fears of AI-driven attack risks.

items.headline: Justin Drake Urges 'Bunker Mode' for Key Recovery
items.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake calls for 'bunker mode' contingency planning against AI-posed private key recovery risks, splitting the industry.
